### What's new
First public release of EcoFun: practical environment quizzes, AI waste scanner with disposal points, community photos with ratings and comments, notifications, and English + Kinyarwanda.

### Ibishya
Verisiyo ya mbere ya EcoFun: ibibazo ku kubungabunga ibidukikije, AI isuzuma imyanda ikaguha amanota iyo uyijugunye neza, amafoto y'umuryango n'ibitekerezo, imenyesha, mu Cyongereza no mu Kinyarwanda.

**Install on Android:** open https://github.com/humuraelvin/EcoFun/releases/latest/download/EcoFun.apk on your phone, then tap Install.
